hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler vaults. In beforeSwap, it fully replaces Uniswap v4's CLAMM with its own invariant: input tokens are taken from the PoolManager and deposited into an Euler vault, output tokens are withdrawn from another Euler vault and paid out, and a BeforeSwapDelta is returned to handle all accounting. Concentrated liquidity positions and donations are blocked via revert.
